content: TypeSafe Java SDK 0.1.0 (official docs site client/ErrorsAndRetries): exceptions TypeSafeException > TypeSafeApiException {400 BadRequest, 401 Authentication, 403 PermissionDenied (missing key), 404 NotFound, 422 UnprocessableEntity, 429 RateLimit +retryAfterMs, 5xx InternalServer > 529 Overloaded, ResponseValidation}; TypeSafeApiConnectionException > TypeSafeApiTimeoutException; client-side MissingAnswer/AnswerType. Default RetryPolicy: 2 retries, 500ms->5s exponential, 25% jitter, retry 408/429/>=500 and connection errors, honors retry-after-ms, 30s total budget; retry sleeps with Thread.sleep. Batch API systemOneAll default concurrency 4. Published limit 1,200 req/min.
